_comment: This file is a declarative MMPretrain configuration file for SimCLR with ResNet-50. It contains no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points — only configuration dictionaries (model, optim_wrapper, train_dataloader, default_hooks). No tool-use examples are applicable.
review_simclr_config: review the SimCLR ResNet-50 config file for model architecture and optimizer settings
summarize_simclr_config: summarize the SimCLR self-supervised learning configuration including backbone, neck, and head settings
build_simclr_model: build a SimCLR model using ResNet-50 backbone with NonLinearNeck and ContrastiveHead from this config
run_simclr_training: run SimCLR pretraining on ImageNet using this config with LARS optimizer and cosine LR schedule
refactor_simclr_config: refactor the SimCLR config to change batch size, learning rate, or checkpoint interval
